create_competition: create a Hugging Face competition by calling _create with token, organization, name, hardware, metric, and submission config parameters
check_user_can_create_competition: check if a user can create a competition by calling check_if_user_can_create_competition with their Hugging Face token
create_readme_for_competition: create a README BytesIO object for a competition space by calling _create_readme with the competition name
run_gradio_competition_creator: run the Gradio Blocks UI for creating Hugging Face competitions by calling main and launching the demo
review_create_function: review the _create function to understand how it creates dataset repos, uploads config files, and sets up competition spaces on Hugging Face
